title: Théorie arithmétique. Théorie de Galois des motifs (1965) : notes manuscites (s.d.), tapuscrit (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page has nothing to do with the motif and Galois-theory notes around it. It is page 13 of a typescript, filed upside down, apparently reused paper. The text is Bourbaki-style ('séries absolument sommables', 'prop.7', 'prop.8', 'formule (6)'), on analytic functions of p variables over a complete valued field K, possibly non-archimedean. It is most likely a draft for Bourbaki's 'Variétés différentielles et analytiques' or a similar Bourbaki redaction.

The page finishes the proof that a holomorphic function, meaning one locally given by an absolutely summable power series, is differentiable. Expand f(u+w) as
  f(u) + Σ D_k f(0) w_k + Σ f_k(u) w_k + Σ_{Σm≥2} b(n,m) u^n w^m,
where the f_k have no constant term. The remainder, with Σm ≥ 2, is then bounded on the polydisc |u_k|, |w_k| ≤ r/2. With t = sup|w_k| and M = sup ||b|| r^{Σ(n+m)}, it is at most M t^2 (r^{-2}) Σ (1/2)^{Σn} (t/r)^{Σm-2}. The series converges for t ≤ r/2, so the remainder is O(t^2), uniformly in u.

This remainder bound, together with continuity of power series, gives the differentiability formula (6). The differential at z is w ↦ Σ D_k f(z) w_k, identified with the element (D_k f(z))_k of E^p.

Corollary: since the partial derivatives D_k f are again holomorphic (prop. 7), induction shows holomorphic functions are C^∞. The page closes with the definition, for p = 1, of a zero of order h at a: the first nonzero term of the expansion in powers of z−a has exponent h. It begins a remark about characteristic 0, presumably that the order is then detected by derivatives.
errors: The majorant omits a factor r^{-2}. From ||b|| r^{Σ(n+m)} ≤ M one gets ||b|| |u^n w^m| ≤ M (1/2)^{Σn} (t/r)^{Σm} = M (t/r)^2 (1/2)^{Σn} (t/r)^{Σm-2}, so the bound should read M t^2 r^{-2} Σ ... rather than M t^2 Σ .... This is harmless for the O(t^2) conclusion.

Minor point: convergence of the majorant series over all multi-indices (n), (m) uses t/r ≤ 1/2 < 1 together with polynomial growth of the number of multi-indices. Implicitly the bound must be applied with t ≤ r/2 fixed and monotonicity in t. This is fine but left implicit.

ideas.what: Holomorphic (locally convergent power series) functions over a complete valued field are differentiable, with differential given by partial derivatives; proof via an O(|w|^2) bound on the remainder of the double expansion
ideas.modern_name: Differentiability of analytic functions over complete valued fields
ideas.usually_credited_to: Classical (Weierstrass); in this generality, Bourbaki, Variétés différentielles et analytiques (fascicule de résultats); Serre, Lie Algebras and Lie Groups, Part II
ideas.where_published: Standard in Bourbaki VAR and Serre's LALG Part II

ideas.what: Order of a zero of a one-variable analytic function
ideas.modern_name: Order of vanishing / multiplicity of a zero

deep.surprise_reason: This is a routine typescript page from a Bourbaki-style treatment of analytic functions over valued fields, apparently on reused paper. It has no connection to the motif and Galois-theory content of the folder, and no original content.
transcription_corrections: The page image is upside down; the transcription reads it in the correct orientation.
The image shows the majorant written as 'M t^2 Σ (1/2)^{Σ n_k} (t/r)^{(Σ m_k)-2}'. The transcription is faithful, but mathematically a factor r^{-2} is missing.
The handwritten archive page number '50' appears in the corner and is not part of the typescript; the typescript page number is '- 13 -'.
